change.title: fix(server,web): bounded replay holes, accepted-turn retry dedupe, cross-device fan-out, turn state
change.description:
## Summary

A `subscribe` with `lastSeq=0` on a long session hung forever: when a seq in `cursor+1..frontier` was missing from both disk and the ring (opencode's first `available_commands_update` arrives before session registration, so it's dropped from disk), the replay loop `continue`d forever, re-flushing and re-reading the whole JSONL every pass — the keepalive watchdog killed the socket after 75s with no reply. A Retry after a mid-turn connection drop re-sent the same prompt, so side-effecting turns ran twice. A second device never received the agent's reply text (its turn state looked idle, so agent chunks were gated off). After a reload the UI showed no spinner or stop button while the agent was still streaming.

This PR bounds the replay loop (holes below the durable frontier are skipped with a warn; a hole at/above it returns a Stale-style reply), buffers events that arrive before persistence registration and flushes them on registration (via a real `EventSink` trait override — the trait default no-op made the flush dead code), proves prompt acceptance client-side (`acceptedServerPromptTurnIds`) so a transient drop resubscribes instead of re-sending, un-gates agent chunks on the second device by deriving the open turn from the live `user_prompt` echo, and adds `turnActive` to session payload metadata with client-side derivation on every install path.

## Related Issue

Closes #836
Closes #846
Closes #847
Closes #838

## Type of Change

- [x] fix: bug fix

## What Changed

- `web/sink.rs`: pre-registration event buffer + flush on `note_session_registered` (inherent method + trait override delegating to it, so `Arc<dyn EventSink>` callers reach the real flush); `REPLAY_MAX_PASSES` + `missing_seq_ranges` hole-skip; deleted-session events are skipped with the accurate log line (not buffered).
- `acp/manager/command_loop.rs`: notify sinks after `register_session` and promote.
- `acp/session_payload.rs`: `turn_active` metadata (camelCase `turnActive`, skip-if-false) derived from the last unmatched `user_prompt`; covers full and tail payload materialize.
- Renderer: `deriveOpenTurn` helper; `openHistorySessionInner` + `resumeLiveSession` install `activeTurn`/`openTurnId` from metadata/transcript; live `user_prompt` echo marks the turn active on non-busy sessions (second devices); `acceptedServerPromptTurnIds` — prompt echo adds, success deletes, transient-error-after-accept keeps the turn and suppresses the banner (no re-send); agent crash clears the accepted set so Retry re-sends.
- #844 (partial): `messageCount` now counts materialized messages consistently (bubble openers only) with a versioned heal on install; send_prompt timeout behavior lives in #867.
- Tests: missing_seq_ranges unit test, timeout-guarded subscribe-with-hole acceptance, pre-registration flush (inherent + trait-path regression), #847 fan-out test, prompting.test.ts suite (34), session payload serialization.

- [x] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (in src-tauri)
- [x] `cargo test` (in src-tauri)

Not applicable — replay/protocol behavior; covered by unit and acceptance tests.

commits.message:
fix(server): terminate replay on durable holes, fan out agent chunks, derive turn state (#836 #846 #847 #838 #844c)

(events dropped before register_session installed the writer) now skips
after one re-read pass instead of spinning the per-session replay gate past
the keepalive watchdog. REPLAY_MAX_PASSES bounds the loop; pre-registration
events are buffered in the sink and flushed via the new
EventSink::note_session_registered hook (wired at session/new + promote), so
the JSONL keeps a contiguous seq run. The misleading "skipped event for
deleted session" log now states both real causes.

user_prompt echo landed) now resolves as outcome-unknown in runPromptTurn —
activeTurn/openTurnId stay set, no error banner, no queue re-send; the
transport reconnect resubscribes and prompt_complete closes the turn via
replay. Re-send remains allowed only when no echo ever arrived.

subscriber is now covered by a server test; the renderer second-device gap
was the turn state — _onUserPrompt now marks the turn active (openTurnId
gate in mayStartChunkMessage opens the streaming bubble).

turnActive (open_turn_from_records: trailing user_prompt with no matching
prompt_complete); the renderer deriveOpenTurn uses it (or the transcript
tail) on reopen so the spinner/stop button show immediately.

append_record counts message_count under the exact materializer fold rules
(bubble openers only — metadata events and coalesced chunks never count);
tool_call closes the run across both JSONL logs. install_runtime runs a
versioned write-back heal recounting legacy metadata (fold_open_role
absent) so index and payload counts converge.

fix(server): dispatch note_session_registered through the EventSink trait (#836)

impl EventSink for WsRelaySink now overrides the trait's no-op default
and delegates to the inherent flush, so the Acp command loop's
Arc<dyn EventSink> calls actually flush pre-registration events in
production (the default made the #836 early-event buffer dead code).
Adds a regression test that drives the flush through the trait object.

fix(web): derive open turn on resumeLiveSession; clear accepted turns on agent crash (#838, #846)

resumeLiveSession now derives activeTurn/openTurnId from the installed
transcript + metadata (same helper as openHistorySessionInner), so the
post-reload chat opens with spinner + stop button while the turn runs.
_onAgentCrashed clears acceptedServerPromptTurnIds so a crash after
server acceptance re-sends on Retry instead of resubscribing forever.

+/**
+ * Issue #838: derive the open turn (a `user_prompt` with no matching
+ * `prompt_complete`) from an installed transcript. The server's session
+ * metadata may carry `turnActive` (authoritative, set when the host knows a
+ * turn is running); the transcript derivation covers older hosts and any
+ * window where metadata lagged. Returns the open turn id (`turn:<turnId>`)
+ * or null. A turn id missing from the bubble (older records) yields
+ * `turn:<lastUserSeq>` so the stop button + spinner have a stable handle.
+ */
+export function deriveOpenTurn(
+  messages: ChatMessage[],
+  metadataTurnActive?: boolean
+): string | null {
+  // The open-turn signals, most-reliable first: the host's `turnActive`
+  // metadata flag, else the transcript tail (a trailing user bubble with no
+  // assistant reply after it — a streaming turn may have zero agent output
+  // yet, so absence of a reply is not proof of completion, but its presence
+  // IS proof the turn finished).
+  if (metadataTurnActive) {
+    // Metadata says a turn runs; recover the id from the last user bubble.
+    for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+      if (messages[i].role === 'user') {
+        return messages[i].id.startsWith('turn:')
+          ? messages[i].id
+          : messages[i].seq != null
+            ? `turn:seq-${messages[i].seq}`
+            : `turn:open-${i}`
+      }
+    }
+    return null
+  }
+  // Trailing-derivation: the transcript ends with a user message that has no
+  // turn:<id> completion behind it. We cannot see prompt_complete records
+  // from ChatMessage[] alone, but an assistant reply AFTER the last user
+  // message implies the turn finished (the reply streams during the turn and
+  // finalizes at completion). A trailing user bubble with NO assistant
+  // message after it means the turn is still open.
+  let lastUserIdx = -1
+  for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+    if (messages[i].role === 'user') {
+      lastUserIdx = i
+      break
+    }
+  }
+  if (lastUserIdx === -1) return null
+  const agentAfter = messages.slice(lastUserIdx + 1).some((m) => m.role === 'agent')
+  if (agentAfter) return null
+  const last = messages[lastUserIdx]
+  return last.id.startsWith('turn:')
+    ? last.id
+    : last.seq != null
+      ? `turn:seq-${last.seq}`
+      : `turn:open-${lastUserIdx}`
+}

+describe('issue #846: transport drop after server-accepted prompt', () => {

+    // `user_prompt` echo lands first. A later WS drop then leaves the outcome
+    // UNKNOWN — the agent keeps running server-side and the reconnect
+    // resubscribe replays the rest of the turn. `runPromptTurn` must keep
+    // `activeTurn` + `openTurnId` (spinner/stop button stay) and NOT set
+    // `lastError` (the Retry affordance must not blindly re-send a prompt
+    // that is already running).

+    // The dispatch promise rejects with the transport-drop error later.
+    let rejectDispatch!: (reason: unknown) => void

+      new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
+        rejectDispatch = reject
+      })

+    useAcpStore.getState()._onUserPrompt({
+      agentId: 'agent-1',
+      sessionId: 's1',
+      turnId,
+      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'do the deploy' }]
+    })
+    // Now the connection drops mid-turn.

+      new (await import('@/lib/acp-transport')).AcpTransportError('closed', 'WebSocket closed')
